product_metadata.title: 1790 Half Gallon Glass Jar with Airtight Leakproof Plastic Lid, Wide Mouth Easy to Clean, Dishwasher Safe, Food Safe - Kombucha Tea, Kefir, Canning, Sun Tea, Fermentation, Food Storage, 4 Jars
features: Let's Start Brewing - You receive four glass jars with airtight plastic lids. This is the perfect starter kit for all of your brewing, fermenting, or storing needs.

Heat Resistant up to 350ºF - This jar is heat resistant up to 350ºF which means you can pour your boiling water right into it and begin brewing your Kombucha, Sun Tea, or any other hot liquid without having to wait for the water to cool down.

Airtight & Leakproof Plastic Lid - This lid is high quality and will not break. The plastic lid comes with a removable seal to make it airtight and leakproof. It will also not corrode or rust like metal lids.
Toxin Free - The airtight glass jar is certified food grade which means that it is safe for all types of food and liquid.

One Half Gallon of Personalization - With the Glass Jar Storage Containers with Lids, the only limit to what they can be used for is your imagination! Brew with them, decorate with them, store treats for your favorite furry friends in them! Customize without limits!
